source_note: The trained arm is a per-cell softmax rule fitted by deterministic full-batch gradient descent on (damaged neighborhood -> target token) pairs from the training split. It never receives the target template at repair time and is evaluated only on held-out grids. The site_aware arm uses the same trained model but additionally observes the damage event's destroyed positions (never the destroyed tokens): it refills exactly those wound sites with model-predicted tokens. The assisted arm keeps the target-template local attractor as the upper-bound baseline, and the no-repair arm shows unrepaired decay.

limitations: The model is a linear softmax over one-hot neighborhood and position features, not a neural cellular automaton with hidden state.
It only fills empty cells; it cannot relocate or delete misplaced cells.
It learns one species-level shape prior across the corpus and cannot distinguish individual grid variants.

decision.reason: The blind trained arm still falls short of the assisted stability bar, but the wound-site arm — the same trained model, additionally observing which positions the damage event destroyed (never the destroyed tokens, never a template) — meets all three bars on held-out grids. Refill restricted to reported damage sites removes overgrowth by construction, so the residual error is purely token prediction. Template assistance is no longer required for stability when damage-site observability is available.

limitations: The trained rule is a linear softmax, not a neural cellular automaton with hidden state.
matrix_overlap does not penalise spurious fills, so structural_agreement is reported alongside it; the trained arm overgrows relative to the assisted baseline.

The site_aware arm assumes damage events report destroyed positions; it would not apply to damage whose location is unobserved, and its verdict is recorded under its own threshold key for that reason.
Held-out grids come from the same hand-authored species corpus, so the split tests variant generalisation, not novel-species generalisation.
No human visual repair ratings are included.
